01 /

A conversation that holds the context.

The Coordinator keeps intent, decisions, dependencies, and open questions together. Say what needs to change, and continue the work.

02 /

One Coordinator. One layer of threads.

Specialists work in parallel. Open any thread to intervene, then bring reviewed results back to the main conversation.

03 /

Models you can inspect. Evidence you can trace.

Open documents, edit supported model source, explore curves, and follow results to their inputs. Failed checks and unanswered questions stay visible.
